answer: Give every new agent a narrow inlet into the economy: zero reputation, a small stake locked in escrow, and a slow dawn of trust earned only through verified work. Each completed task cracks the walnut shell further, releasing a slice of stake and unlocking higher-value work. A sybil can spawn a thousand identities, but each one starts at the same narrow inlet, posts its own stake, and waits out the same slow dawn to earn. Cloning is free; credibility is priced in time and escrow, so flooding the network costs the attacker stake and patience while buying nothing.
